description: This file defines Lua functions for rendering a menu bar and menu items using a custom 'luax' library, implementing UI components for a web interface.

methods.name: Menuitem
methods.description: Creates a menu item with label and optional sub-options, rendering an 'li' element with nested links.

methods.name: Menubar
methods.description: Creates a menu bar containing multiple menu items, rendering a 'ul' element with 'li' children.
